description: This file declares the interface for generating AWS Signature Version 4 headers in the cURL project. It primarily contains a function declaration used to produce AWS SigV4 authentication headers, which is likely invoked by other parts of the cURL codebase when interacting with AWS services.

methods.name: Curl_output_aws_sigv4
methods.description: Creates an AWS SigV4 authorization header for HTTP requests, used internally within cURL when authenticating requests to AWS services.
